Additional operative acceptance from intake review: one declared source for secondsPerTr and participant aliases, read by SherlockSceneCoding and gold_scene.py; a cross-language synthetic fixture checks every admitted participant mapping and TR value. Mutating either implementation or the declared rule must fail the agreement witness. Do not substitute Python-vs-Python agreement. No real gold access is needed for this rule check.

Current prerequisites (replace historical dependency prose): bd-01M2WVCEBHAZBKJQ0EB84EA4HV

Scheduling lane: foundation. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

2026-09-19 operative acceptance amendment (docs/refactor/PLAN.md):
Preserve all existing fixed-population/unit-ID criteria; add separate timing eligibility, transcript-order eligibility and transition coverage. Synthetic load_arm probe on baseline retained 1 of 3 rows; no corpus gold read.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19; governing docs/refactor/PLAN.md.
Preserve all existing fixed-population/unit-ID criteria; add separate timing eligibility, transcript-order eligibility and transition coverage. Synthetic load_arm probe on baseline retained 1 of 3 rows; no corpus gold read.

Original scope retained below for evidence; fleet procedure/assignments are historical and do not govern single-developer work.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §3 Phase 1a Step 2.

Today gold_scene.py fails open: it drops unlabelled rows silently (:108-112), drops misnamed files (:199), and `paired` never checks that two arms scored the same units (:171). A two-unit probe scored 50% with one wrong prediction and 100% when that prediction was blank. The primary estimand is the participant-average difference, which is what `paired` computes (:170-181) and what the ledger reports. This ticket reads no gold on real participants: its tests use synthetic fixtures. Reproducing the historical B3 numbers is a ledgered read in the baselines ticket.

Scope:
Export a unit manifest from the current pipeline; make the scorer reconcile, type outcomes and fix denominators.

Acceptance criteria:
1. B3's unit manifest (arm all17-monofill; 2,560 RecallSegmenter units, 67-351 per participant) is exported with stable unit id, participant, ordinal, text checksum, onset seconds and source-input checksum; it lives under the ignored data root and only its hash is committed.
2. The scorer reconciles each arm against the manifest and exits non-zero with a named reason on missing, duplicate or extra unit ids, changed unit identity (text checksum or onset) and unexpected participant files.
3. Each unit carries a typed outcome (label, abstention, invalid, provider failure). Abstention, invalid and failure count as wrong in the primary exact-scene denominator when the unit has gold; units without gold are accounted for but outside the denominator; gold eligibility is computed from gold alone.
4. Output reports input count, gold-eligible count, every outcome and exclusion count, and coverage.
5. Primary estimand: the mean of per-participant exact-scene differences; the pooled unit-weighted difference is a labelled secondary series; both arms use the same frozen denominator and unit weights, including inside paired resamples.
6. CI method, seed and resample count come from a committed config; output includes per-participant differences and a leave-one-participant-out sensitivity table.
7. Mutation-witness tests on synthetic fixtures: dropping, duplicating or changing one unit id makes the paired run fail; blanking a wrong label or replacing it with a failure never raises primary accuracy; a no-gold unit stays accounted for without becoming an error; the two-unit probe scores the blank as wrong.

Gate: every script in tools/recall-study/tests exits 0 (`for t in tools/recall-study/tests/test_*.py;
do python3 "$t" || exit 1; done`), new tests included; a named mutation witness per new guard; no
recall prose or participant text committed (hashes and aggregates only); fresh-context cold review;
the commit body states the evidence and what it does not establish.

Size: M.
